name: Modular methanol synthesis
short: Containerized gas-to-methanol unit next to the flare (as Rise Reforming, YC S26)
product: methanol — the hydrate inhibitor and drilling-fluid component that oil companies currently import
assumption: CAPEX ≈ ₸3.2 bn per 5,000 t/year module (≈5.5 M m³/year); methanol ₸250,000/t; 1,100 m³ of gas per tonne. Our assumption.
vendor_example: Rise Reforming (YC S26) — modular reforming of biogas and associated gas into DME and methanol

name: Gas-engine power plant
short: Gas burns in an engine-generator; electricity goes to the field or the grid
product: electricity, 3.5 kWh per m³ (replaces diesel generators and coal grid power)
assumption: CAPEX ≈ $1,000/kW at 7,500 h/year; tariff ₸25/kWh; 35% efficiency. Our assumption. Needs a grid connection or on-site demand.
vendor_example: Standard gas gensets (Jenbacher, Caterpillar, Chinese equivalents)

name: Mini-LNG / CNG
short: Liquefy or compress, truck to filling stations and boiler houses
assumption: wholesale fuel-gas price ₸70/m³; CAPEX benchmark for 10–50 M m³/year units. Our assumption.
vendor_example: Mini-LNG modules (Galileo Technologies, Cryostar, Chinese equivalents)

name: Reinjection into the reservoir
short: Gas is compressed and pumped back underground — no emissions, no revenue
product: compliance only (Zero Routine Flaring 2030), reservoir pressure support
assumption: compressor-station CAPEX benchmark. Our assumption. Shown for comparison as 'compliance without income'.
